description: This file contains unit tests for the HealthcheckService class, which manages health check pings for server sessions. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as ping sending, timeout handling, server removal, and acknowledgment processing.

classes.name: HealthcheckServiceTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the HealthcheckService, providing setup, utility methods, and mock objects for unit tests.

methods.name: timerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and configuring the timer used for periodic health checks.

methods.name: pingWillBeSent
methods.description: Sets expectation that a ping event will be sent and captures the ping ID.

methods.name: errorIndicationWillBeSent
methods.description: Sets expectation that an error state change will be notified for the server.

methods.name: createSut
methods.description: Creates the System Under Test (HealthcheckService) with optional custom interval.

methods.name: triggerPingTimeout
methods.description: Simulates the timer callback to trigger a ping timeout event.

methods.name: triggerOnPingSent
methods.description: Simulates the event that a ping has been sent with a specific ping ID.

methods.name: triggerOnServerRemoved
methods.description: Simulates the event that the server has been removed.

methods.name: triggerOnAckReceived
methods.description: Simulates the reception of an acknowledgment with server ID, ping ID, and success status.
